events.title: Club toilet lock
events.text: Sweat, bass, strobe. A grinding adult slut pulls you toward the toilets by your belt: 'I don't even know your name. I want your cock in my mouth NOW.'

effects.tpl: Locked door, her on her knees on piss-wet tile, choking on your cock while the bass pounds. Then bent over the sink, fucked hard till she squirts on the mirror. You leave first. Legend.
You hand her water and dance. She pouts, then respects it. Morning texts: 'you're different.'

events.title: Fresh divorcee
events.text: Divorce finalized today. The adult across from you downs her third drink: 'Ten years of vanilla missionary. Tonight I want to be treated like a whore. Can you do that?'

effects.tpl: Face slaps, hair pulling, throat fucking, spit on her tits — called every filthy name while she cums harder than a decade of marriage ever gave her. She texts at 3am: 'again.' Corrupted right.
Slow, sweet rebound sex with {{n2}}. She sleeps on your chest. No damage done.

events.title: Ex at the door
events.text: Your adult ex stands in the rain at midnight: 'He doesn't fuck me like you did. One night. Nobody has to know I came here.'

effects.tpl: You fuck {{n}} like a debt collected — hair gripped, hips bruised, cumming with her nails in your back. 'Still mine,' you growl. She doesn't argue. Reclaimed.
Cold rain, closed door. You jerk off angry and sleep clean. Growth hurts.

events.title: Steam room
events.text: The adult regular from the squat rack corners you in the empty steam room, towel slipping: 'Everyone stares at your body. I want to feel how strong you really are.'

effects.tpl: Steam, tile, her legs over your shoulders on the bench — pounded deep while she bites her towel to stay quiet. Two cums each. The janitor knocks. You finish anyway.
You spot her PR instead. She gets your Instagram. Slow burn.

events.title: Thumb out
events.text: Adult hitchhiker, short skirt, long legs, no money: 'I'll pay any way you want if you get me to the city by midnight.'

effects.tpl: Layby, engine running: her head bobbing in your lap, gagging, swallowing, then bent over the hood for a hard roadside pounding. You drop her in the city glowing. Fare paid in full.
You drive, talk, ask nothing. She cries a little at the drop — nobody's been kind in months.

events.title: Towel door
events.text: Your adult neighbor opens in nothing but a towel, dripping: 'Shower broke. Mind if I use yours... or are you just going to stare at my tits all day?'

effects.tpl: Towel hits your floor. You eat her dripping cunt on your couch till she screams, then fuck her with her legs in the air, cumming on her tits. Now she 'borrows sugar' every week.
Hot water, clean towels, closed door. She brings pie after. The slow game.

events.title: Overtime mouth
events.text: 9pm. The adult coworker in the tight skirt bends over the copier 'by accident' again: 'Still here, huh? Buy me dinner... or just take it out of my bonus.'

effects.tpl: blinds shut, her face in the keyboard, skirt up — fucked senseless on the quarterly reports while she drools on your forecasts. You keep the security still as insurance. Owned at work now.
You keep it professional. HR never hears your name. The promotion track stays clean.

events.title: Sleeper cabin
events.text: Overnight train. The adult stranger in your sleeper compartment locks the door, draws the blind: 'Twelve hours. No names. Do whatever you want with me.'

effects.tpl: Rocking carriage, locked door: mouth, cunt, throat, ass cheeks spread — fucked in every position the bunk allows, cumming three times before dawn. You part at the platform as strangers. Perfect.
You snore. She reads. Dawn comes innocent. Rare self-control.

events.title: Reality TV casting
events.text: Casting agents want YOU for a reality show: 6 weeks, $10k, possible fame.

then.tpl: Fan favorite! $10k + 200k followers!

else.tpl: Edited as the villain. $10k consolation.

effects.tpl: Dignity intact.

events.title: Hate follows fame
events.text: Success brings stalkers, think-pieces, and 4,000 quote-tweets about your haircut.

effects.tpl: Assistants, boundaries, beach. Peace restored.
Never read the comments. You read the comments.

events.title: Feast invitation!
events.text: A wealthy cousin invites House {{s.lastName}} to a grand feast: roast, wine, gossip.

effects.tpl: You toast, dance, network. +10 prestige!
Your gift steals the night. Bards mention House {{s.lastName}}. +22 prestige!
You stay home. The pies were apparently legendary.

events.title: Family feud!
events.text: A rival branch of the family insults House {{s.lastName}} at a gathering. Everyone watches.

then.tpl: Your toast is so sharp it cuts. The hall erupts. +18 prestige!

else.tpl: Your comeback lands flat. Whispers follow you.

then.tpl: 6-0, 6-1. Dinner tastes like victory. +14 prestige!

else.tpl: You lose. They are insufferable about it.

effects.tpl: Grace disarms them. The elders nod. House honor grows.

events.title: Flat at midnight
events.text: Midnight, rain, nowhere: a tire strands {{s.firstName}} as trucks spray past.

then.tpl: Twelve wet minutes. Soaked, triumphant.

else.tpl: The jack wins round one. You win round two, shivering.

effects.tpl: Warm car, warm wait, warm bill.

events.title: The sushi
events.text: The gas-station sushi seemed fine at the time to {{s.firstName}}. It was not fine.

effects.tpl: Diagnosed: never again. You frame the discharge papers.

then.tpl: Twenty-four brutal hours. You survive on crackers.

else.tpl: Dehydrated and humbled. The ER anyway: minus $700.

events.title: Grandchild!
events.text: Your child calls, voice shaking with joy: you're going to be a grandparent!

effects.tpl: Tiny hands, huge love. Grandparent mode: activated.
Books, calls, birthday magic from afar.

events.title: Sharp pain!
events.text: Something pops during a heavy lift.

effects.tpl: Strain, not tear. $600 and six boring weeks.

then.tpl: It fades. You feel invincible (wrongly).

else.tpl: Torn ligament. Months of regret.

events.title: Gym era
events.text: Everyone's getting fit. The gym offers a teen deal.

effects.tpl: Six months of iron. Transformation arc complete.
Push-ups in the bedroom. Slow but real gains.

events.title: Hackathon weekend
events.text: 48-hour hackathon. Free pizza, no sleep, big prizes.

then.tpl: Your app wins 2nd place! $1,500!

else.tpl: No prize, but you learn more in 48h than a semester.

effects.tpl: You sleep 10 hours while friends hallucinate code.

events.title: Weird lump
events.text: You find something odd. Dr. Google says everything from 'nothing' to doom.

then.tpl: Benign! $500 for the best sleep of your life.

else.tpl: Early-stage issue caught early. Treatment works. Scary year.

then.tpl: It vanishes. You feel smug and lucky.

else.tpl: It was serious. Ignoring it cost your health dearly.

events.title: The covenant festival
events.text: Once a decade the houses throw open their gates together — one long festival of oaths renewed, grievances shelved, and honey cakes the size of shields.

effects.tpl: Hand on the charter stone, you swear peace with the houses. The crowd cheers; the honey cakes are historic. +10 prestige.
Three days of feasting. You remember the dancing; the dancing remembers you.

events.title: Vultures over marble
events.text: Word spreads that a Great House teeters — debts, no clear heir, creditors circling. Ruin is a market like any other, and you have coin.

effects.tpl: You own a house's obligations now, which is nearly owning the house. They receive you standing. +18 prestige.

then.tpl: Your name joined to theirs saves their banners and raises yours. The city applauds the rescue. +25 prestige, +5 fame.

else.tpl: They spit on the offer and survive anyway — now with a grudge engraved. −8 prestige.

effects.tpl: You study exactly how a great house falls: slowly, then at the creditors' meeting. A free education in power.

events.title: Paper with a pulse
events.text: A Great House quietly offers you its harbor bonds at a discount — they need coin now, you have coin now. Paper with a pulse.

then.tpl: The bonds mature fat. +${{g}} total returned, and a house that pays its debts. +8 prestige.

else.tpl: The house defaults sideways and settles for pennies. +${{g}} salvaged. Never lend to banners.

effects.tpl: You pass. Someone else's paper, someone else's panic.

events.title: The quiet embargo
events.text: The houses have decided your company charges too little and knows too much. Harbor masters suddenly can't find your paperwork.

effects.tpl: Paperwork found, seals stamped, smiles sharpened. Business resumes. −$4,000.

then.tpl: Your speech at the guildhall shames the embargo into history. Merchants cheer your name. +10 fame, +12 prestige.

else.tpl: The embargo tightens instead. Your company bleeds −$8,000 before a judge intervenes.

events.title: A seat at the high table
events.text: A sealed invitation arrives: a Great House holds its winter feast and your name is on the seating chart — near enough to the salt to matter.

effects.tpl: You toast the host in the old words and mean them. Doors open that money alone never could. +12 prestige.
Silver candlesticks, no card. They notice the taste, if not the absence. +3 prestige.

then.tpl: Your absence becomes the gossip of the feast — played exactly right, it reads as power. +6 fame.

else.tpl: Played wrong. The slight is remembered at every table that matters. −15 prestige.

events.title: Borrowed knives
events.text: Two houses feud over harbor dues and both want YOUR name on their side of the petition. Refusing both is also a statement.

effects.tpl: You pick the winner early and the winner remembers. The loser does too. +15 prestige, −6 karma.

then.tpl: You talk both houses down from the ledge. The city calls you the peacemaker. +25 prestige, +8 karma.

else.tpl: The talks collapse and both sides blame the mediator. −10 prestige.

effects.tpl: You plead harvest, headache, anything. The feud burns on without you.

events.title: An heir's indiscretion
events.text: A young heir of a Great House is caught somewhere they should not have been, with someone they should not have been with — and the fixer comes to YOU, because you know how to keep a secret.

effects.tpl: Witnesses paid, records misplaced, heir grateful. A house now owes you silence-priced favors. +14 prestige.

then.tpl: The scandal blooms beautifully and your name is nowhere on it. +10 fame, −12 karma.

else.tpl: Traced to your doorstep. The house denies everything and ruins your week. −20 prestige.

effects.tpl: You send the fixer away. Your conscience is clean; the heir is, reportedly, not. +6 karma.

events.title: Gilded patronage
events.text: A house chapel needs a new roof, a house poet needs a pension, a house library needs everything. Great names are built on giving — visibly.

effects.tpl: Your name is carved over the chapel door in letters a foot high. God and the city both notice. +20 prestige, +10 karma.
The poet's new epic features a suspiciously heroic patron with your name. +8 fame.

events.title: Whispers in the gallery
events.text: You hear something ruinous about a Great House — true enough to wound, loose enough to deny. Words are weapons that leave no fingerprints. Usually.

then.tpl: By week's end every salon repeats your whisper as their own discovery. A rival house bleeds standing; you gain it. +20 prestige.

else.tpl: The whisper is traced to your table. Liars are remembered longer than scandals. −18 prestige.

choices.label: Sell the secret back to them

then.tpl: They pay handsomely for your discretion. +${{g}}. Everyone understands the arrangement.

else.tpl: They call your bluff and bury the story — and your reputation with it. −10 prestige.

effects.tpl: Some weapons are too dirty to hold. You wash your hands of it.

events.title: A signet changes hands
events.text: Heraldry news: somewhere in the city, an old head has died and a new one lifts the signet. Every succession reshuffles who owes whom — including you.

effects.tpl: Black-edged letters and good wine. The new head receives you first among the new faces. +12 prestige.
You update your mental map of debts and grudges. Knowledge is leverage that never rots.

events.title: The gilded lists
events.text: The houses hold a tourney — swordplay, horsemanship, archery — and common blood may enter for a fee. The crowd loves an underdog.

then.tpl: You unhorse a baronet's nephew and the crowd ROARS your name. +14 fame, +18 prestige.

else.tpl: You last three bouts and leave with a limp, a story, and the crowd's pity-cheer. +3 fame, −10 health.

then.tpl: Your pick takes the wreath! +${{g}} from the bookmakers.

else.tpl: Your champion face-plants in the mud. There goes a thousand.

effects.tpl: Pennants, thunder, honeyed nuts. A perfect afternoon with no bruises.

events.title: The war chest comes knocking
events.text: Open war between two houses, and every merchant with a pulse is asked to contribute to somebody's war chest. Refusal has a price; so does loyalty.

effects.tpl: Gold buys neutrality with a receipt. Both armies march past your doors. +10 prestige.

then.tpl: Your gold arrives masked and your side wins the season. Gratitude, deniable and deep. +22 prestige.

else.tpl: The funds are traced. Your side loses anyway. −12 prestige.

then.tpl: Grain to one camp, iron to the other, both at war prices. +${{g}}. War is good business if you never lose.

else.tpl: Profiteering exposed by a vengeful quartermaster. Fined and named. +10 record.

events.title: A ward of your house
events.text: A widowed cousin of a Great House asks you to foster their youngest for a few years — a ward, an honor, and unmistakably a mouth to feed.

effects.tpl: The child arrives with one trunk and excellent manners. Your house grows warmer and worthier. +15 prestige, +12 karma.
You send toys and a kind letter instead. The cousin understands — mostly.

events.title: Bells between houses
events.text: Two Great Houses join bloodlines and the whole city is invited to watch. Your invitation is edged in gold leaf — someone wants you seen there.

effects.tpl: You outshine half the wedding party and nobody minds. Both houses remember your generosity. +20 prestige.
Good wine, better gossip. You leave with three new acquaintances and no enemies. +5 prestige.

events.title: Kitchen fire!
events.text: Grease fire! Flames lick the cabinets.

effects.tpl: Fast action saves the house. $2,500 damage.
Water spreads grease fire! $12,000 damage. Never again.

events.title: Boar hunt!
events.text: Friends (or vassals, you joke) plan a weekend boar hunt. Mud, dogs, glory.

then.tpl: A clean chase! The boar feeds the village. +14 prestige!

else.tpl: The boar disagrees. Muddy, bruised, humbled.

effects.tpl: You guard the pies. Someone must.

events.title: Letter from a lawyer
events.text: A distant relative left you something in their will.

then.tpl: A check for ${{w}}! You cry a little.
A box of letters and a pocket watch. Priceless, not spendable.

else.tpl: JACKPOT: ${{w}}! A paid-off house sold for you.

events.title: Big interview
events.text: A good job wants YOU for an interview tomorrow.

else.tpl: You ramble about your cat for 6 minutes. No offer.

events.title: You have been summoned
events.text: A summons orders {{s.firstName}} to jury duty: a two-week fraud trial. The boss sighs audibly.

effects.tpl: You weigh a stranger's fate carefully. Civic soul plus.

then.tpl: A crucial dentist appointment frees you.

else.tpl: Contempt warning plus $250 fine. Oops.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your graduate"}} holds a thick envelope with a university crest. Hands shaking.

effects.tpl: {{k&&k.grades>=70?"ACCEPTED! Screaming, cake, phone calls till midnight.":"Waitlisted — but the hug is full-size. Plans forming."}}
Tuition math at the kitchen table. Dreams, itemized.

text.template: Ms. Alvarez folds her hands. 'Let's talk about {{k?k.name:"your child"}} — grades {{k?k.grades:60}}, conduct '+(k&&k.trouble>3?'...lively':'a delight')+'.'

effects.tpl: 'Keep doing whatever you're doing at home,' she says.
Flashcards at breakfast. The curve bends upward.
No console till the grades move. They move.

text.template: The corner shop calls: {{k?k.name:"your kid"}} was caught pocketing sweets. The owner wants 'to make it a lesson.'

effects.tpl: Humiliation shared is humiliation halved. Lesson landed.
Forty minutes of shopkeeper thunder. Never again, apparently.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" ("+(k.trait||"young")+", wants "+(k.dream||"everything")+")":"Your grown kid"}} asks the big one over dinner: 'What should I do with my life?'

effects.tpl: 'Then go be it brilliantly.' They exhale like they've held that breath for years.
Contacts called, internship secured. Gratitude, delayed.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your kid"}} comes home with a split lip and a story that starts mid-sentence.

effects.tpl: 'Strong people forgive first.' It lands, eventually.
Pillow lessons all weekend. Nobody touches your kid again.

text.template: {{k?k.name+", backpack bigger than torso, ":"Someone small "}}faces the school gates. A {{k&&k.trait?k.trait:"brave"}} who dreams of being an {{k&&k.dream?k.dream:"explorer"}}.

effects.tpl: Hand squeezed all the way to the classroom door. Then — gone, grinning.
They walked in alone and were fine. You weren't.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your teen"}} comes home dry-eyed in the way that means crying happened elsewhere.

effects.tpl: Two hours, one tub of ice cream. They'll survive — and remember you were there.
'Plenty of fish' lands exactly as badly as expected.

text.template: Floorboard creak. {{k?k.name:"Your teen"}} freezes halfway out the window, caught red-handed.

effects.tpl: An hour of honest talk. The window stays shut after that.
Alarms, curfews, checks. Peace through paperwork.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" lets go of the couch. ":"A small miracle unfolds. "}}Wobbly. Arms out. The whole room holds its breath.

effects.tpl: Three steps! Four! The video gets watched a hundred times.
Shaky footage, perfect audio: everyone screaming with joy.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" ("+(k&&k.dream?"future "+k.dream:"big dreams")+")":"Your kid"}} made the talent-show finals and is vibrating with nerves.

effects.tpl: They scan the crowd, find you, and shine twice as bright.
Practice between chapters. Both improve, unevenly.

events.title: School calls
events.text: The school calls: your kid is in trouble. Again.

effects.tpl: A long walk, hard truths, a hug. They turn a corner.
Silence. Then slow thaw.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your child"}} announces the wedding. Date set. Your duties: show up, don't cry (cry), pay for something.

then.tpl: Flowers, tears, dancing. +10 prestige for House {{s.lastName}}.

else.tpl: The wallet says no. The day is smaller, the love isn't.

effects.tpl: Backyard vows, borrowed chairs, perfect.

events.title: Rent spike!
events.text: Landlord raises rent 30%. 'Market rates,' he shrugs.

effects.tpl: You pay. Resentment included free.
Smaller place, longer commute, $1,200 moving costs.

then.tpl: You charm him into 5% instead. Legend.

else.tpl: He laughs. You pay full spike.

events.title: Layoffs!
events.text: Your company cuts 20%. Your manager wants 'a quick chat'.

then.tpl: You survive the cut + $3,000 retention bonus!

else.tpl: Laid off. Severance $4,000. Job hunt begins.

effects.tpl: You take $7,000 severance and walk tall.

events.title: Lucky ticket?
events.text: Jackpot $40M. A ticket is $5. The line buzzes with hope.

then.tpl: IMPOSSIBLE. You win $2M (lump, taxes)! SCREAMING!

else.tpl: Numbers dance. Not yours.

effects.tpl: You keep the $5. Statistically victorious.

events.title: Scratch ticket
events.text: A friend gifts a $2 scratch ticket for fun.

then.tpl: $500 winner!! You scream in the store!
$10 back. Breakfast is free.

else.tpl: Dust. Still fun.

effects.tpl: You pass the luck along.

events.title: Marathon dare
events.text: Friends dare you to run a marathon in 4 months.

effects.tpl: Mile 20 breaks you, mile 26 rebuilds you. FINISHER!
You hold the sign. They cry at the finish.

events.title: Old rival
events.text: Your old rival challenges you: tennis match, Saturday. Loser cooks dinner.

then.tpl: 6-0, 6-1. Dinner tastes like victory.

else.tpl: You lose but gain a training arc.

effects.tpl: Laughs > score. Rival becomes friend.

events.title: Write it down?
events.text: Grandkids beg: 'Write your stories before they're gone.'

then.tpl: Self-published. It sells 3,000 copies! $15k!

else.tpl: 312 pages of gold. Family treasure forever.

effects.tpl: Porch stories it is.

events.title: A kid needs you
events.text: A struggling teen at work/school asks you to mentor them.

effects.tpl: Years later they credit you with everything. You cry.
You decline. The guilt lingers.

events.title: A kid needs you
events.text: A struggling teen asks you to mentor them — homework, heartbreaks, hope.

effects.tpl: Years later they credit you with everything. You cry. +10 prestige!
New instruments for the whole club. Joy echoes.

events.title: Red convertible syndrome
events.text: You catch yourself staring at a red convertible. The dealer waves.

effects.tpl: V8 therapy. You feel 22 at red lights.
Ten glorious minutes. Wallet intact.

events.title: Job abroad!
events.text: A firm in another country offers +40% pay but you know nobody there.

effects.tpl: New country, new you. Salary now ${{s.salary}}!
Home wins. No regrets (mostly).

events.title: Dark alley
events.text: A figure steps out: 'Wallet. Now.'

effects.tpl: You lose ${{l}}. Shaken, alive. That's what matters.

then.tpl: Training pays! They flee. You shake for an hour.

else.tpl: Beaten and robbed (${{l}}). Hospital visit.

then.tpl: Gone like wind. Adrenaline for days.

else.tpl: Caught, shoved, robbed $300.

events.title: Old soul
events.text: The shelter's oldest dog watches you with ancient eyes.

effects.tpl: Mabel naps on your feet from day one. Old souls know.
You fund the vet bills. Mabel finds a farm to retire on.

events.title: Weak moment
events.text: A business trip, attention, an open door. The marriage is at stake.

effects.tpl: You call home instead. The marriage never knows how close. You do.
Honest talk, hard week. Trust rebuilt stronger for the telling.

events.title: First angel check
events.text: A friend's startup needs 10,000 dollars. The deck glows.

then.tpl: Ten-x exit! 40,000 dollars returns like a miracle.

else.tpl: Zero. The lessons cost exactly 10,000 dollars.

effects.tpl: Free advice, kept cash. The friendship survives either way.

events.title: Forty and loud
events.text: Forty approaches. The party must match the milestone.

effects.tpl: A hundred friends, one band, zero regrets. Forty: launched.
Desert weekend with twelve. Intimate and legendary.

events.title: Partner fracture
events.text: Your business partner wants out. The buyout number lands heavy.

then.tpl: Painful price, full control. Profits triple: 30,000 ahead.

else.tpl: You overpay slightly. Control still worth it.

effects.tpl: You exit clean with 25,000 dollars. New chapter, cash in hand.

events.title: Whiteout weekend
events.text: Snow seals the cabin. Firewood, wine, no road out.

effects.tpl: Three days of firelight and talk. The marriage bank overflows.
You trench to the road heroically. Neighbors cheer.

events.title: Honest night
events.text: Wine, candles, the talk about what you both actually want.

effects.tpl: Midnight confessions, tangled sheets, deeper trust. Wanting, named and met.
You listen for hours. Understanding becomes its own intimacy.

events.title: Rival bid
events.text: A rival firm offers 30 percent more. Your team loves you.

effects.tpl: The jump pays: 18,000 dollars more and a bigger canvas.
Your firm matches halfway. Loyalty plus 9,000 dollars.

events.title: Underground river
events.text: A guided cave river: headlamps, silence, ancient stone.

effects.tpl: Lights off, floating. The dark has weight and wonder.
Stalactites in long exposure. The earth shows off.

events.title: Smoke call
events.text: A supplier fire halts your line. Orders pile.

effects.tpl: Expensive air freight saves the quarter. Clients stay.
You call every client personally. Most wait. Trust compounds.

events.title: Profit share
events.text: A record quarter. Bonuses or reinvestment?

effects.tpl: Bonuses all around. Morale soars; loyalty locks in.
New equipment ordered. 12,000 dollars planted for spring.

events.title: Talent raid
events.text: A rival courts your best three people with absurd offers.

effects.tpl: Raises and promises. All three stay. Loyalty: purchased fairly.
One leaves gracefully. The team reshapes stronger.

events.title: Picket math
events.text: Your workers vote to strike. The demands land Friday.

effects.tpl: Raises given, strike averted. Loyalty for a decade.
Half now, half later. Handshakes all around.

events.title: Overnight brand
events.text: Your product explodes online. Orders 40x overnight.

then.tpl: You fulfill the flood. 25,000 dollars and a brand is born.

else.tpl: You drown in orders. Refunds sting, lessons stick.

effects.tpl: Limited run, flawless delivery. Scarcity becomes strategy.

events.title: Usual order
events.text: The corner cafe learns your name. Then your order. Then your life.

effects.tpl: Ten years of usuals. The barista speaks at your wedding.
Generous always. The staff saves you the good seat.

events.title: Reef week
events.text: The reef before it changes. A dive boat, a week, a mask.

effects.tpl: Certified Monday, turtles Tuesday, wonder all week.
Shallow gardens amaze. The reef gives freely.

events.title: Silence retreat
events.text: Four days, no talking, desert stars. The mind itches already.

effects.tpl: Day three breaks you open beautifully. Quiet becomes a friend.
Two silent days. Enough to hear yourself again.

events.title: Milky Way tour
events.text: A guided dark-sky night with telescopes the size of cars.

effects.tpl: Saturn's rings live. Gasps ripple through the dark.
Four friends, one sky. The drive home is all wonder.

events.title: Viral week
events.text: Your video hits ten million views. The week goes strange.

then.tpl: Sponsors flood in. 15,000 dollars for being yourself loudly.

else.tpl: Fame evaporates by Friday. Screenshots remain.

effects.tpl: No interviews. The internet moves on. Peace kept.

events.title: Wheels and meals
events.text: A used food truck lists cheap. Your recipes are ready.

then.tpl: Lines around the block. 18,000 dollars profit year one.

else.tpl: Permits eat you alive. Sold at a loss, lessons kept.

effects.tpl: Weekend pop-ups prove the concept. 2,000 dollars banked.

events.title: Show up
events.text: A teen in foster care needs a steady adult. One evening weekly.

effects.tpl: Two years of Thursdays. Graduation: you cry hardest.
You fund outings for ten pairs. Joy multiplies.

events.title: 2am call
events.text: A friend calls crying at 2am. Everything is broken.

effects.tpl: You sit with them till dawn. Friendship: proven in the dark.
You arrive at seven with food and a plan. Still counts.

events.title: Sunset charter
events.text: A sunset sail for two. The harbor glows gold.

effects.tpl: On the bow, at golden hour: yes. The captain cheers.
Dolphins escort you home. The evening needs no agenda.

events.title: Balloon crew
events.text: The balloon team needs ground crew for race weekend.

effects.tpl: Dawn launches, field landings, champagne tradition. You are hooked.

then.tpl: A seat opens! You float the valley at sunrise. Speechless.

else.tpl: No seat this year. The chase thrills anyway.

events.title: Steam and snow
events.text: Hot springs in falling snow. The contrast heals.

effects.tpl: Snow on your hair, heat in your bones. Bliss physics.
Roll in snow between soaks. Alive does not cover it.

events.title: Grease fire
events.text: The pan ignites. The alarm screams. Seconds matter.

effects.tpl: Lid on, stove off, heart hammering. Disaster: declined.
Foam everywhere, kitchen saved. 200 dollars of reset.

events.title: Ring road
